title: Resource request observation
description: Open context written by the BEAR.EventSourcing observation bridge for one BEAR.Resource invocation. The uri is canonical (path only); the query lives in params. The timestamp is absolute ISO-8601 with an explicit offset; an entry without one is never extracted as an event.

params.description: Request parameters as a string-keyed map; an empty map serializes as an empty JSON array.

replayable.description: False when a ParamsFilterInterface withheld a value from params (a credential, typically). SemanticLogExtractor extracts the request either way and carries the flag onto Event::$replayable for the replay engine to read. Optional and defaults to true — an entry recorded before this field existed, or written by a hand-built context, is treated as replayable; a non-boolean value is treated as not replayable.
